$comment: Scope-to-keychain-to-permission-key map for OAuth scopes (docs/mcp-operation-contract.md). A scope is a keychain: each scope names one keychain defined in build/permissions.csv (Security Management / Keychains) and lists the existing permission keys, by their generated constant names, that the keychain carries for the operations the scope covers. The scope strings themselves are defined once, in schemas/extensions/mcp-operation.yaml; validation/mcp_scopes_test.go keeps the two in step. build/generate-permission-golang.js and build/generate-permissions-ts.js read this file and emit OAuthScopeGrants (Go) and OAuthScopes (TypeScript).

content:read.description: Read the content items of the organization.

content:write.description: Create and edit content items of the organization. Never approves them.

schedule:read.description: Read the schedules of the organization.

schedule:write.description: Create and change schedules of the organization, and set or lift its schedule pause.

connections:read.description: Read the connections of the organization.

events:read.description: Read the events of the organization, including run results.

account:read.description: Read the signed-in account and the features of the organization.
